name: Tennessee
agency: Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security, Driver Services Division
permitAge: 15 (Level 1 Learner Permit), after written and vision tests

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night (certified on form SF-1256)
teen.nightLimit: Learner permit: no driving 10 p.m. to 6 a.m. Intermediate restricted: no driving 11 p.m. to 6 a.m. unless with a parent/guardian or licensed driver 21+ (other exceptions in TCA 55-50-311)
teen.passengerLimit: Intermediate restricted: one passenger, unless a licensed driver 21+ is in the car
teen.phone: Learner and intermediate license holders: no cell phone use while driving (TCA 55-50-311). All drivers since July 1, 2019: hands-free law, no holding a phone.

notes: Learner permit holder must have a licensed driver 21+ in the front seat.
Intermediate restricted license at 16 after 180 days on the permit, 50 hours (10 at night) and a road skills test.
Intermediate unrestricted license after holding the restricted license one year (wallet card; age requirement not confirmed).
Knowledge test can be taken online (English or Spanish); under-18s proctored by a parent or guardian per one source.
Move over (TCA 55-8-132): emergency, tow, highway maintenance, solid waste and utility vehicles; since 2017 any stopped vehicle with flashing lights. Change lanes if safe, otherwise slow down.
School bus on a highway divided by a median or barrier: oncoming traffic need not stop but must go with caution; traffic behind must stop.
Interstate maximum 70 mph reported by secondary sources only; not used in questions.
